Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity desktop landing page mockup for Tactix, a bespoke cleaning service. Render the website edge to edge at approximately 1536 x 1152, with crisp readable typography and no browser, device, desk, surrounding presentation board or mockup label. Both attached images are BRAND REFERENCES, not edit targets. Use their Tactix wordmark, royal cobalt blue, white, mint accent, geometric tile motifs and pairing of a heavy geometric sans-serif with a high-contrast upright editorial serif. Preserve the recognisable wordmark from the reference, including its custom T construction and sparkle. This is a working website composition, with visible navigation, clear buttons, service content and the start of a further section, not a poster. Do not invent reviews, ratings, years of experience, prices, guarantees, service areas, qualifications or NDIS registration. All content is Australian English. Use these actual contact details only where they suit the composition: hello@tactixshine.au and 0481 993 560. Keep readable body text and strong contrast.
Concept 1, Precision in white. An editorial composition led by typographic contrast and a beautifully clean, naturally lit residential living space photograph. Spacious white ground, cobalt headlines and thin cobalt rules. The existing geometric tile border becomes one confident narrow vertical brand detail, with only tiny mint interruptions. Top navigation contains Tactix, Services, Our approach, Contact, and a blue "Get a quote" button. Hero reading order: headline "A beautiful clean. Down to the last detail." in large refined serif with restrained heavy sans emphasis; supporting text "Bespoke residential and end-of-lease cleaning, with care for the details."; "Get a quote" button and secondary "Explore our services". A large cropped interior photograph supports the copy without stealing focus. Beneath, a disciplined horizontal services section headed "A clean for every chapter." offers "Residential", "End of lease" and "NDIS cleaning", the last with "Available upon request". Include the supplied tagline "Where precision meets perfection" as a quiet brand sign-off. Preserve editorial whitespace, fine alignment and clear website functionality.
